name: bfast-client
description: Client for ⚡ B-FAST (Binary Fast Adaptive Serialization Transfer) - Protocolo de serialização binária de ultra-alta performance

scripts.build: npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/streaming.test.js dist/tests/type-preservation.test.js dist/tests/schema-and-query.test.js
scripts.sync-version: node -e "const v = require('fs').readFileSync('../Cargo.toml','utf8').match(/^version = \"(.*)\"/m)[1]; const pkg = require('./package.json'); pkg.version = v; require('fs').writeFileSync('./package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n');"

author: marcelomarkus
